question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **who**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option is "who" because it is the appropriate relative pronoun to refer to the subject of a clause, which in this case is "people."
 
• Grammatically, "who" is used as the **subjective pronoun** to refer to people.
 
• In the given sentence, it connects the idea that people may seek fashion as part of who they are and who they want to be.

Therefore, the correct word that must fit the blank: **who**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine the other options and why they are incorrect:
 
 
• **which:** "Which" is used to refer to objects or animals, not people. It is not suitable in this context where the reference is to human identity.
 
• **whom:** "Whom" is an object pronoun used to refer to the object of a verb or preposition. In this sentence, "whom" does not fit because it does not refer to the subject "people."
 
• **whose: **While "whose" can be used to indicate possession or association, it is typically used for inanimate objects or people and does not appropriately convey the meaning of personal identity in this sentence.
